EMGW14N8voa1b36LSuTxxw.name: 客服班组（官方种子）

steps.title: 订阅安装并实化
steps.body: 从智能体市场订阅本包，在应用中心按模板实化——团队生而全队暂停，先确认组织再点燃。

steps.title: 直接开始
steps.body: 点燃后每 4 小时：一线客服处理工单并报数、质检员抽检合格率、组长汇总未决工单。CRM 工具未配置时岗位会如实报「未取得」——这是平台的诚实纪律，不是故障。

steps.title: 拿到班组台账
steps.body: 去驾驶舱看卡墙（未决工单/处理件数/首响时长/质检合格率）；疑难工单组长会合并成拍板项等你裁决。

steps.title: Subscribe and materialize
steps.body: Subscribe in the Agent Market, materialize in the app center; teams start paused — confirm structure first.

steps.title: Start right away
steps.body: Every 4 hours once lit: support works and reports tickets, QA samples pass rates, the lead consolidates open tickets. Missing CRM reads as 'not obtained' — honesty discipline, not a fault.

steps.title: Read the desk ledger
steps.body: Watch the cockpit card wall (open/handled/first-response/QA pass); hard tickets surface as decision items for your call.
